title: Running Commentary on Torah 60 — Pasach R' Shimon v'Amar
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 60 — פתח ר' שמעון ואמר
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Ha'Idra Rabba Kaddisha** (Naso 128).

intermediate.en: **Idra Rabba** (Naso 128).
intermediate.he: **אדרא רבה** (נשא קכח).

beginner.en: **"Pasach R' Shimon v'amar: **'Eis la'asos la'Hashem.'** Amai **'eis la'asos la'Hashem'**? Mishum **d'heferu Torasecha**. Mai **d'heferu Torasecha**? Torah d'l'eila d'ihi misvat'la iy lo yis'a'abed b'tikunei da. U'l'Atik Yomin iti'mar. K'siv: **'Ashrecha Yisrael, mi kamocha,'** u'chsiv: **'Mi kamocha ba'eilim Hashem.'** Kar'a l'R' Elazar breih, oisvah kameih, u'l'R' Abba mi'sitra achra, v'amar: **'Anan kelala d'kola.'** Ad kan ism'tanu kaymin. Ishtiku, shamu kala, v'arkavasan da l'da nakshan. Mai kala? Kala d'knufya ila'ah d'mis'kanfi."** (Idra Rabba opening; Zohar Naso 128.)

intermediate.en: **Idra Rabba opening**: R' Shimon on "eis la'asos la'Hashem"="Torah d'l'eila mis'bat'la iy lo yis'a'abed b'tikunei da." Seats Elazar + Abba; "anan kelala d'kola." Kol nakshan (knees knocked); kala d'knufya ila'ah.
intermediate.he: **פתיחת אדרא רבה**: ר"ש על "עת לעשות"="תורה דלעילא מתבטלת אם לא יתעבד בתיקונים אלו". מסדר אלעזר+אבא; "אנן כללא דכולא". קול נקשן (ברכיים); קלא דכנופיא עלאה.

intermediate.en: **"א"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"א"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"Know: there are **shvilei ha'Torah** with **great hisbonenus** — unreachable except via **ashirus**. Just as in **pshatei Oraysa** — **'im ein kemach ein Torah'** (Avos 3:17) — needs at least parnasah, so for this hisbonenus needs **very great ashirus**. Must have **hon rav**; **'lo sachser kol bah'**. All wealth of world is needed for this hisbonenus. **B'nei Yissachar** had this hisbonenus (Divrei Ha'Yamim I 12:33): **'u'mi'b'nei Yissachar yod'ei binah l'itim, la'da'as mah ya'aseh Yisrael'** — they **understood the times** via very great ashirus-hisbonenus."**

intermediate.en: **α. Shvilei Torah with great hisbonenus** needs **ashirus gedolah** (Avos 3:17 "im ein kemach"). B'nei Yissachar (DH I 12:33 "yod'ei binah l'itim"). Hon rav = all world-wealth.
intermediate.he: **α. שבילי תורה בהתבוננות גדולה** דורשים **עשירות גדולה** (אבות ג, יז "אם אין קמח"). בני יששכר (דה"א יב, לג "יודעי בינה לעיתים"). הון רב = כל הון העולם.

scholarly.he: סעיף א. אבות ג, יז; דה"א יב, לג.

intermediate.en: **"ב"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ב"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"To reach this ashirus — via **tikunei Atik = arichus yamim = zakein**. Must **lengthen/expand days**. Every day is initially **narrow** — hard to do the avodah (davening, learning); must start little-by-little. **Arichus yamim** = see to **lengthen + enlarge** one's days, expanding with **tosfos kedushah** each time."**

intermediate.en: **β. Ashirus via tikunei Atik=arichus yamim=zakein**. Expand each day with **tosfos kedushah**.
intermediate.he: **β. עשירות ע"י תיקוני עתיק=אריכות ימים=זקן**. הרחבת כל יום ב**תוספת קדושה**.

intermediate.en: **"ג"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ג"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"**Zakein** bechina = widening/lengthening days with tosfos kedushah via **yirah** — **'yiras Hashem tosif yamim'** (Mishlei 10:27). **'Yiras Hashem hi otzaro'** (Yeshayahu 33:6); Berachos 61a: **'asa'ah k'otzar'** — narrow above, wide below. Day-beginnings are narrow; they widen via yirah's tosfos kedushah. Thus via **yirah → arichus yamim → hisbonenus-ashirus**."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Zakein via yirah** ("yiras Hashem tosif yamim," Mishlei 10:27; "otzaro," Yesh 33:6; Ber 61a "asa'ah k'otzar"=narrow top, wide bottom).
intermediate.he: **γ. זקן דרך יראה** ("יראת ה' תוסיף ימים", מש' י, כז; "אוצרו", יש' לג, ו; בר' סא "עשאה כאוצר"=צר מלמעלה, רחב מלמטה).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. מש' י, כז; יש' לג, ו; בר' סא.

intermediate.en: **"ד"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ד"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"**Shleimus ha'yirah via 3 kavim**: **morah shamayim, morah rabcha, morah av va'em** (Avos 4:12, etc.). Complete when there is a **chacham ha'dor with fitting talmidim + fitting banim**: chacham = morah shamayim; talmidim = morah rabcha; banim = morah av va'em. Each of the 3 must be **kellalus of 3 (triple-composite)** — rabo's morah kellalus of shamayim/rabcha/av, etc."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Shleimus yirah 3 kavim**: morah shamayim / rabcha / av va'em (Avos). Chacham+talmidim+banim. Each kellalus of 3.
intermediate.he: **ד. שלמות יראה ג' קווים**: מורא שמים / רבך / אב ואם (אבות). חכם+תלמידים+בנים. כל אחד כלול מג'.

intermediate.en: **"ה"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ה"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"Hisgalus ha'yirah via **pkidus akaros** (barren women remembered/opened). Via **leidah**, yirah is revealed — **'r'adah achazasam, chil ka'yoledes'** (Tehillim 48:7). Birth releases **damim+gevuros** = yirah. Especially when a long-barren woman is remembered — the damim/gevuros were dammed up longer → yirah-hisgalus stronger. **Per hisgalus of barren-remembered so hisgalus yirah** strengthens in the world."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Yirah-hisgalus via pkidus akaros** (Teh 48:7 "r'adah... chil ka'yoledes"). Leidah→damim/gevuros=yirah; akarah-pkudah=stronger.
intermediate.he: **ה. גילוי יראה ע"י פקידות עקרות** (תה' מח, ז "רעדה... חיל כיולדה"). לידה→דמים/גבורות=יראה; עקרה שנפקדה=חזק יותר.

intermediate.en: **"ו"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ו"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"Pkidus akaros made via **awakening people from their sleep**. There are people who **sleep through their days** — though it seems they serve Hashem (learning, davening), all their avodah **doesn't rise above**: all stays **below** because **ikkar chiyus=sechel** (**'ha'chochmah techayeh,'** Kohelet 7:12). Avodah with sechel has chiyus rising upward; but **mochin d'katnus=sheinah**. To **show him his panim** + wake him — must **clothe the panim in sipurei ma'asiyos**. There are **70 panim la'Torah** = 70 years (each differs). Must clothe for 3 reasons: (i) like healing an eye — must shut it so it doesn't see the light suddenly; (ii) tzimtzum the ohr for a long-sleeper; (iii) covers the **ohr from suitable-klipos that would steal it**."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Pkidus akaros via awakening sleepers**. Avodah without sechel stays below. Wake via **sipurei ma'asiyos** clothing **70 panim la'Torah** — 3 reasons (heal-eye, tzimtzum ohr, cover from klipos).
intermediate.he: **ו. פקידות עקרות ע"י הקצת הישנים**. עבודה ללא שכל נשארת למטה. הקצה ע"י **סיפורי מעשיות** מלבישים **ע' פנים לתורה** — ג' טעמים (ריפוי עין, צמצום אור, כיסוי מקליפות).

beginner.en:
**Clothing the panim in sipurei ma'asiyos** — the core teaching of this section. **"There are 70 panim la'Torah, and they are the bechinah of the 70 shanos"** (each year a different face/aspect). The panim must be clothed **dayka** — specifically — for **three reasons** (the 3 ta'amim):

**(i) Like healing an eye**: just as one must shut the eye so it not see the light suddenly, the long-sleeper's 'eye' (= his sechel) cannot tolerate the panim's undimmed light; clothing = shutting his eye so it heals.

**(ii) Tzimtzum the ohr for the long-sleeper**: his mochin d'katnus cannot absorb full ohr; sipurei ma'asiyos are a **tzimtzum-vessel** that narrows the ohr to what he can receive.

**(iii) Covers the ohr from the klipos that would steal it**: bare panim would be **stolen by klipos matching** that panim; clothing in a story-narrative is a disguise that allows the ohr to reach the recipient without being intercepted.

These three reasons are **cumulative**: without the clothing, the ohr either burns the receiver (1), overwhelms him (2), or is stolen en route (3).

intermediate.en: **Sipurei ma'asiyos cloaking** — **70 panim la'Torah = 70 shanos**. Three ta'amim: (i) heal-eye (shut to light); (ii) tzimtzum ohr for sleeper's mochin d'katnus; (iii) cover from klipos that would steal.
intermediate.he: **הלבשת סיפורי מעשיות** — **ע' פנים לתורה = ע' שנים**. ג' טעמים: (א) ריפוי עין (סגירתה לאור); (ב) צמצום האור לשינה (מוחין דקטנות); (ג) כיסוי מפני קליפות הגונבות.

scholarly.he: ע' פנים לתורה = ע' שנים; ג' טעמי ההלבשה.

beginner.en:
**ז. When engaging to awaken people, one must guard himself from talmidim lo hagunim** — ungentlemanly students — lest **their ra** (evil) **cleave to him** and damage him. **Chazal (Chullin 133a)**: **"Kol ha'm'lamed talmid she'eino hagun, nofel b'Gehinnom"** — anyone who teaches an unworthy student falls into Gehinnom. Similarly, **Chazal (Shabbos 108a)** forbade **writing on the hide of a tamei beast** — **"l'ma'an tihyeh Toras Hashem b'ficha"** (Shemos 13:9) = **"min ha'mutar l'ficha"** — only on that which is permitted may Toras Hashem be written.

**Why is teaching analogous to writing?** Because **teaching another is the bechinah of kesivah**: the tongue is **"leshoni eit sofer mahir"** (Tehillim 45:2) — 'my tongue is the pen of a skilled scribe' — and speech carves the teaching into the **hide of the listener's tongue** (i.e., into the interior of his being). Hence one who teaches a talmid lo hagun is in the bechinah of **writing on impure skin** — and the same issur applies: his Torah becomes a **kli tamei** that will not hold the ohr.

intermediate.en: **§ז. Guard from talmidim lo hagunim** (Chul 133a "kol ha'm'lamed talmid she'eino hagun"). Shab 108a: writing on tamei skin forbidden — "min ha'mutar l'ficha" (Shem 13:9). Teaching = kesivah; tongue = "sofer mahir" (Teh 45:2) carving into hide-of-listener.
intermediate.he: **§ז. שמירה מתלמידים לא הגונים** (חול' קלג. "כל המלמד תלמיד שאינו הגון"). שב' קח.: כתיבה על עור טמא אסורה — "מן המותר לפיך" (שמ' יג, ט). לימוד = כתיבה; לשון = "סופר מהיר" (תה' מה, ב) הרושם בעור השומע.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. חול' קלג.; שב' קח.; שמ' יג, ט; תה' מה, ב.

beginner.en: **ח.** (Source seg 17 is the bare heading letter ח for the next section.)

intermediate.en: **"ח"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ח"** כותרת.

beginner.en:
**ח. Chazal (Sanhedrin 100a)** on the pasuk **"v'aleihu li'srufah"** — 'and its leaves are for healing' (Yechezkel 47:12): **"l'hatir peh ilmim u'l'hatir peh akaros"** — to loosen the mouth of mutes and to loosen the mouth of barren women.

**Rebbe's peirush**: via **awakening people from their sleep through sipurei ma'asiyos** — which is the bechinah of **"v'aleihu li'srufah"** (the 'leaves' that clothe/cover the ohr) — two things happen:

**(a) "L'hatir peh ilmim"**: before the awakening, the sleepers were like **mutes** — they couldn't even hear the chacham's words clearly enough to respond, let alone speak in response. After the awakening, their **ears are opened** to receive and their **mouths are opened** to reply. **Zohar (Titzaveh 186b)**: **"Zakaa ma'an d'm'malel al adna d'shamei'a"** — 'fortunate is the one who speaks into an ear that hears.'

**(b) "L'hatir peh akaros"**: literally to open the mouth of barren women — **when the peh-akarus is opened** (by the awakening), **the pkidus-of-akaros** (§5 above) **follows**. The two miracles are one process: the awakening opens both the speech-mouths and the womb-mouths.

**The bridge to the Torah's opening**: §5 revealed that the essential hisgalus of yirah is via pkidus akaros. §7-8 reveal that pkidus akaros itself comes via awakening-through-sippurei-ma'asiyos. So the whole arc — from the Torah's opening on "hisnosesus" to the shofar-section coming next — is one continuous path: hisnosesus→awakening→sipurei ma'asiyos→peh-opening→pkidus akaros→yirah→arichus yamim.

intermediate.en: **§ח. San 100a on Yech 47:12** "v'aleihu li'srufah" = **"l'hatir peh ilmim + akaros"**. Via sipurei ma'asiyos awakening: (a) peh ilmim = ears open + mouths reply (Zohar Titzaveh 186b "zakaa man d'm'malel al adna d'shamei'a"); (b) peh akaros = pkidus akaros follows. Bridge: hisnosesus → awakening → sipurei ma'asiyos → peh opening → pkidus akaros → yirah.
intermediate.he: **§ח. סנ' ק על יחז' מז, יב** "ועלהו לתרופה" = **"להתיר פה אלמים + עקרות"**. דרך סיפורי מעשיות: (א) פה אלמים = אוזניים נפתחות (זוה"ק תצוה קפו: "זכאה מאן דממלל על אדנא דשמיע"); (ב) פה עקרות = פקידת עקרות. גשר: התנוצצות → הקצה → סיפורי מעשיות → פתיחת פה → פקידת עקרות → יראה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ח. סנ' ק.; יחז' מז, יב; זוה"ק תצוה קפו:.

beginner.en:
**ט. Bechinah of shofar** = **hisor'rus ha'sheinah** (the awakening-from-sleep motif itself). As brought in the sifrei Kabbalah, shofar alludes to **"Uru y'shenim mi'tardeim'chem"** (Rambam, Hilchos Teshuvah 3:4, as a paraphrase of the shofar's meaning: awaken, sleepers, from your slumber).

Through shofar comes the same **l'hatir peh ilmim + l'hatir peh akaros** of §8. And the three shofar-sounds correspond to three stations of the dibbur-pkidus chain:

- **Teki'ah** = **heder ha'dibbur** (the blockage/want of speech) — **"taka'ta l'zar kapecha, nokash'ta b'imrei picha"** (Mishlei 6:1-2) — 'you have struck your palm for a stranger, you have been snared by the words of your mouth': the person blocked by his own speech-traps.
- **Teru'ah** = **dibbur itself** (breaking through) — **"siftei tzaddik yir'u rabim"** (Mishlei 10:21) — the tzaddik's lips shepherd many.
- **Shevarim** = **bitachon/breaking of the self** — **"sivro al Hashem Elokav"** (Tehillim 146:5) — 'his hope is on Hashem.' (Alt. reading: **shevarim** as **shever** — breaking — the breaking of heder-ha'dibbur into working speech.)

The three together = awakening → speech-release → bitachon-anchor. This is why **Tekiah-Shevarim-Teruah** is the blowing sequence: wake (teki'ah), break (shevarim), then broken-speech-reformed-as-tzaddik's-lips (teru'ah).

intermediate.en: **§ט. Shofar = hisor'rus ha'sheinah** (Rambam H' Teshuvah 3:4, paraphrase of "uru y'shenim"). Three sounds: **teki'ah** = heder dibbur (Mishlei 6:1-2); **teru'ah** = dibbur (Mishlei 10:21); **shevarim** = bitachon/shever (Teh 146:5).
intermediate.he: **§ט. שופר = התעוררות השנה** (רמב"ם ה' תשובה ג, ד, פרפרזה "עורו ישנים"). ג' קולות: **תקיעה** = הדר דיבור (מש' ו, א-ב); **תרועה** = דיבור (מש' י, כא); **שברים** = ביטחון/שבר (תה' קמו, ה).

scholarly.he: סעיף ט. רמב"ם ה' תשובה ג, ד; מש' ו, א-ב; י, כא; תה' קמו, ה.

beginner.en:
**Tikunei Atik = arichus yamim = zakein.** The shofar is the bechinah of **tikunei Atik Yomin** (the most-transcendent-root rectifications revealed in the Idra Rabba, the next section of this Torah). This is the same as **arichus yamim** (length of days) and the bechinah of **zakein** (elder/aged one).

**Structural parallel**: the zakein's beard (the physical shape of a zakein's face with his beard) is **"katzar mi'lma'alah v'rachav mi'l'matah"** (narrow above, wide below) — narrow at the top (chin), widening as it flows down. So too the **tikunei Atik**: **"tikunei d'kana"** (the 'rectifications of the beard') follow the sod of **"min ha'metzar karasi Kah, anani ba'merchav Kah"** (Tehillim 118:5) — 'from the narrow I called out, Hashem answered me with expansiveness' — starting narrow (=metzar), ending in merchav (=wide expanse).

The **narrow→wide** geometry is the whole secret of the tikunei Atik: ohr enters through a narrow point (tzimtzum/metzar) and **widens into merchav** as it descends. The shofar itself has this shape: narrow at the mouthpiece, widening at the bell. Blowing the shofar = actualizing tikunei Atik = calling from metzar to merchav.

intermediate.en: **Tikunei Atik = arichus yamim = zakein**. Zakein's beard: **"katzar mi'l'ma'alah, rachav mi'l'matah"**. Tikunei d'kana follow **"min ha'metzar karasi... anani ba'merchav"** (Teh 118:5) — narrow→wide. Shofar shape encodes the same.
intermediate.he: **תיקוני עתיק = אריכות ימים = זקן**. זקן הוא **"קצר מלמעלה, רחב מלמטה"**. תיקוני דקנא כסוד **"מן המצר קראתי... ענני במרחב"** (תה' קיח, ה) — צר→רחב. צורת השופר זהה.

scholarly.he: תיקוני עתיק; תיקוני דקנא; תה' קיח, ה.

beginner.en: **"Ta'anis 23a: **"Amar R' Yochanan: kol yamav shel oso ha'tzaddik (Choni)... amar: 'mi ika d'naim shiv'in shnin?' Yoma chada havi kazal b'archa, chazyeh l'hahu gavra d'nata charuva. Amar leh: 'mi'chdi charuva ad shiv'in shnin lo ta'en — p'shita lach d'chayas shiv'in shnin v'achalt minah?' Amar leh: 'ana alma b'charuva ashkachtah; k'heichi d'shasli li avahasai, ana nami shasli li'v'anai.' Yasiv v'kara kaf rifta; asiyah leh shainta v'nim. Hadra alah m'shunisa, v'achsi mei'eina, v'nim shiv'in shnin..."** 'Choni HaMe'agel wondered: does anyone sleep 70 years? Saw a man planting a carob (takes 70 yrs to fruit); man said: my fathers planted for me, I plant for my children. Choni sat to eat, fell asleep; rock covered him; slept 70 years; awoke.'

intermediate.en: **Ta'an 23a Choni HaMe'agel**: carob-planter (70 yrs); Choni slept 70 yrs covered by rock.
intermediate.he: **תענ' כג חוני המעגל**: נוטע חרוב (ע' שנה); ישן ע' שנה תחת סלע.

beginner.en: **Rashi**: **oso ha'tzaddik** = Choni HaMe'agel. **Lo ta'en** = first bearing. **Ahadra lah m'shunisa** = a **sha'ar of the rock** rose around him. **Achsi mei'eina** = people forgot him; did not find him there. **Rimchi rimchi** = foals bearing foals (**'me'uberes zachar hays, v'chazar u'va aleha v'holidah'**).

intermediate.en: Rashi: oso=Choni; lo ta'en=1st bearing; m'shunisa=rock wall; achsi mei'eina=forgotten; rimchi=foals bearing foals.
intermediate.he: רש"י: אותו=חוני; לא טען=טעינה קמייתא; משונית=שן סלע; אכסי=נשכח; רימכי=ולדות.

beginner.en: **"Choni HaMe'agel was **gadol me'od** (same sugya): **'k'she'haya nichnas l'beis ha'midrash, kol kusha she'haya l'Rabbanan haya m'farek'** — no **panim of Torah** was hidden from him. Hence asked: **'mi ika d'naim shiv'in shnin?'** — how can one fall into sheinah from all 70 panim? Even if one falls from one or several, how from all? **'Chazyeh l'hahu gavra d'nata charuva'** — **charuva=zakein=tikunei Atik=arichus yamim** (as above). **'P'shita lach d'chayas shiv'in shnin?'** = do you know for certain you'll live 70 yrs? Meaning: you've reached **tikunei zakein** (70 panim in 70 yrs). **'K'heichi d'shasli li avahasai, ana nami shasli li'v'anai'** — the **zakein-tikkun is handed down generations**."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush Choni**: Choni gadol (no panim of Torah hidden); asked "how sleep 70 yrs?" (= all 70 panim). **Charuva=zakein=tikunei Atik=arichus yamim**. Generational handoff.
intermediate.he: **פירוש חוני**: חוני גדול (אין פנים נסתר); שאל "איך ישן ע' שנים?" (= כל ע' פנים). **חרוב=זקן=תיקוני עתיק=אריכות ימים**. מסירה מדור לדור.

beginner.en: **"Pasach R' Shimon: **'Eis la'asos la'Hashem'** etc. — **'da Torah d'l'eila d'mis'bat'la iy lo ya'seh b'tikunei da, u'l'Atik Yomin iti'mar.'** I.e., the **upper Torah (great hisbonenus)** is nullified/cannot endure unless done via **tikunei Atik=arichus yamim**. **'Ashrecha Yisrael, mi kamocha'** + **'Mi kamocha ba'eilim Hashem'** = **is'arusa d'l'tata** (Israel's praise from below arousing) → **is'arusa d'l'eila**. Entire Idra Rabba = revelation of **Atik Yomin's tikunim** to build/protect the upper Torah."**

intermediate.en: **R' Shimon's Idra petichah**: **Torah d'l'eila bat'la w/o tikunei Atik**. "Ashrecha Yisrael"=is'arusa d'l'tata → d'l'eila. Whole Idra=revelation of tikunei Atik.
intermediate.he: **פתיחת ר"ש באדרא**: **תורה דלעילא בטלה ללא תיקוני עתיק**. "אשריך ישראל"=אתערותא דלתתא → דלעילא. כל האדרא=גילוי תיקוני עתיק.
